fusions.name: Cold Trail
fusions.desc: A thrown jab at an enemy within 7 tiles that deals 5 damage and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health for 20 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Lying in Wait
fusions.desc: You hold still and watch: your critical chance rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Taken
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
